skill: M20 引兽破阵（冲锋前的护甲架势）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright rock-armored rhino warrior in the reference hardens its armor in place. From the resting pose it lowers the horned head, hunches the armored shoulders forward, bends the knees slightly and clenches both fists at its sides, then pounds both fists together once in front of the chest and holds a tense, low braced stance with the horn pointing forward, breathing heavily, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, rhino head and horn, rock armor plates, shoulder armor, belt and kilt. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: hunch into the stance over the first second, fists pound together around one and a half seconds, hold the braced stance until three and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
